threshold_selection: For each fold, select on the immediately preceding five-year validation period, maximizing unique-onset event recall subject to the false-warning limits; ties prefer fewer false-warning months, fewer warning episodes, then a higher threshold. The same model fit is used for validation and subsequent test.
warning_episode_definition: A warning episode is a run of warnings on consecutive monthly forecast origins. It is false only if none of its forecast windows contains an onset.
false_warning_month_definition: A warned forecast origin whose forward outcome window contains no onset.
limitations: Previously examined historical folds: exploratory, not independent validation.
Thresholds are selected on small validation event counts.
The same onset may be covered by multiple warning origins.
Historical predictor values do not prove issue-time availability.
The final test fold excludes forecast origins with incomplete horizon outcomes.
